messages:
maria-cs: Hey team — quick heads up: OrionHealth asked to move their hands-on Open Lab from Wed 11am PT to Thu morning EMEA-friendly window. Can we swap with the slot we have reserved for "Query Tuning Lab" on Thu 9am PT? Need confirmation by EOD so we can update invites. :clock3:
sam-ce: I can take the Thu 9am PT slot if jess can cover Wed 11am PT. :+1:
jess-product: I’m out Wed 11am PT (customer demo). Thu 9am PT works though. Can we shift the agenda to 75m and include a short migration checklist?
maria-cs: noted. If we swap, agenda would be: 1) intros (5m) 2) migration checklist walkthrough (20m) 3) hands-on exercise (40m) 4) Q&A + next steps (10m). Any objections?
oliver-support: I'm on Thu 9am PT but can only join first 45m. Can we record the runbook step? Also can prep a snippet for KV cache checks.
kevin-cs: I can cover the later Q&A slot if needed. Recording + slide deck please.
maria-cs: Cool — sounds doable. I'll update calendar if no objections by 5pm PT. @rota-bot can you attempt to swap the two calendar invites and ping attendees?
rota-bot: calendar-swap initiated for meetings 3612345678 and 3612400000. Conflict detected: attendee conflict for jess-product at 1740-1750. Proposed resolution: auto-delegate to kevin-cs for the earlier slot. Please confirm with "confirm-swap".
jess-product: confirm-swap
sam-ce: Also, quick ask — for the hands-on exercise, can we provide a minimal infra example? Suggest adding this to the prep doc:
```
export REDWOOD_KEY=REDACTED
python run_lab.py --model mosaic --batch 8 --cache on
```
maria-cs: Added to prep doc and invited OrionHealth to the sandbox. Will send pre-read + short survey asking what they want to prioritize (embedding vs reranking). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
oliver-support: leaving a note in the runbook about fallback plan if Dedicated capacity isn't available :memo:
